d:
In this LIVEStream recital, the young and talented Druv Bedi performs the lyrical and devotional evening raga, Yaman Kalyan, followed by a lighter number in Kafi. Bedi’s ability to produce a bright sound on his sitar with exuberant and clear ornamentations is a treat. He learned sitar from his father, Jagdeep Singh Bedi and later on, went to learn from Pandit Budhaditya Mukherjee in the Imdadkhani style in true guru-shishya tradition of prolonged, oral medium of training.
